label: Figure 15.4: Short-run macroeconomic equilibrium
alt: A downward-sloping AD curve and an upward-sloping SRAS curve intersect at one point, giving equilibrium price level PL and equilibrium real output Y.
caption: Short-run macroeconomic equilibrium is where AD crosses SRAS. This fixes the equilibrium average price level PL and real output Y. At this point aggregate demand equals short-run aggregate supply, so there is no pressure for price or output to change.
